purpose: Add an opt-in schema-v4 capability contract to existing immutable read-model manifests; preserve v2/v3 and keep v4 candidate-only.

pullRequestChecks: Flow CI and data QA runs on the pull request and consumes GitHub Actions minutes.
When the PR is merged, a main-branch CI run consumes GitHub Actions minutes.

automaticDeployment.trigger: Deploy Flow Worker listens to pull_request.closed for merged PRs that change web/**.
steps: Run web lint and production contract tests.
Run npx wrangler d1 migrations apply flow --remote.
Verify the deployed build identity through the protected release endpoint.
automaticDeployment.remoteMigrationStateAtMerge: PR #137 deployment completed the migration step successfully and its immediate preflight reported no migrations; recheck immediately before this merge. This PR adds no migration SQL.

runtimeCompatibility.schemaV4: Advertised only as an opt-in candidate capability; importer requires stage_only and activation rejects it.
runtimeCompatibility.defaultProducer: Remains schema v3; no production workflow opts into v4.

resourceBounds.d1RowsReadWrittenByNewCode: None; schema-v4 validation uses the existing bounded manifest/artifact list and adds no database query.
resourceBounds.r2ObjectsReadByNewCode: None during deployment; no candidate is uploaded or verified in this PR.
resourceBounds.actionsBudget: One PR CI run is required; merge would additionally trigger main CI and the Worker deployment workflow.

mergeSideEffects.rollbackAndStop: If Worker deploy or build-identity verification fails, do not run data workflows or switch any pointer. Revert the code PR through a new reviewed PR; v2/v3 production reads remain unchanged.

reviewState: Prepared for CI; remote D1 migration inventory must be checked again before merge authorization.
